propositions: Bedrock cutover silently removed T1's server-side web-search grounding tool because the provider prefix gate `resolved.startswith('anthropic')` no longer matched 'bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8'
T1 is a blocking criterion that now runs without its declared grounding tool, weakening evidence for plan rejection on external integration and security concerns
Web-search capability detection by provider-name prefix violates the epic's zero-exceptions rule that capabilities derive from registry membership not name shape
No signal warns that the declared grounding tool was withheld; the signed verdict's provider_provenance.capabilities omits web-search state
Web access must be guaranteed on every provider T1 can route to; missing it constitutes a measurable fidelity gap between first-class providers (Anthropic vs Bedrock)

The fix eliminates the prefix gate, derives web-search capability from model profile registry membership instead, records the decision as 'native'|'local'|'off' in provenance, and uses pydantic-ai's native-preferred-with-local-fallback pattern to ensure T1 always has web access
